info.title: Denial Navigator API
info.description:
Self-hosted denial-management API (Rust / axum rewrite). Every browser request goes through this gateway; it enforces authentication, role-based authorisation, per-request account currency and HIPAA access auditing.

Auth: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a bearer token. When TOTP is required it returns an mfa-scope token usable only on the `/auth/totp/*`, `/auth/login/totp` and `/auth/me` paths until `POST /auth/login/totp` upgrades it. Sibling services present `X-Service-Key` instead.
